entries.alt: Nephi meets a younger disciple's eyes while supporting him in the water after baptism.
entries.caption: Water runs from the young disciple's robe as Nephi steadies him. After receiving baptism himself, Nephi baptizes those Jesus has chosen.
entries.findings: Compared v2 against original and mapped Nephi reference already directly inspected. Nephi now lowers head and eyes toward the recipient's upturned face, giving meaningful reciprocal attention. Clean-shaven face, nose, lined skin, gray temples and tied hair preserve exact mapped identity. Recipient and support grip, back contact, water and modest clothing remain visually preserved. Natural photographic faces and anatomy; no Christ added.
